visibleInputs: sources/ (through the scenario-dir importer for variant a)
data/replays/e01-claude-arm/<family>.json (one recorded Claude Sonnet subagent pass that read only sources/** and people.json of train and validation families)
hypothesis: Structured rules extraction recovers claim types/links; a Claude-agent arm on the same visible threads may differ (recorded, labeled, not a small-GPT result).

variants.description: The real import path (adapters -> ingest -> context -> rules extractor -> memory commit) on the current working tree; provenance measured
Recorded Claude-agent ExtractionProposals converted to SystemKnowledge and scored directly (NOT run through memory/commit); provenance replay-fixture
The same recorded proposals pushed through the real memory commitProposal (directory ids translated to evidence actor ids, then the directory applied as in the app); provenance replay-fixture

config.armIdentity: one-shot recorded Claude Sonnet subagent (claude-sonnet-subagent-2026-11-07) on visible sources; not the proposed small GPT generator; not an application route; the application never calls it
config.evidenceIdMapping: replay teams:<seq> / email:<Message-ID> / slack:<ts> -> the single non-quoted evidence record with the same provider and seq / Message-ID / ts (benchmarks key); unmatched ids are dropped and counted
config.directScoring: variant b scores the proposals as given: claims verbatim, one case per proposed incident, attempts/outcomes not derived (those come from commit), independent support counted with the importer's own copy/retelling lineage
config.test: test families are never read; fixtures exist only for train and validation

acceptanceCriteria: Report both arms side by side on train and validation separately; no winner is declared.
The rules extractor remains the default route regardless of the result (EXPERIMENT_PLAN E01).
The agent arm informs lexicon fixes only: truth claims it recovered and the rules extractor missed are listed in lexicon-gaps.json.
stopRule: One scoring pass over one recorded fixture per family; skipped if it needed hidden truth or more than one recording pass (the fixtures were recorded once from visible sources only).
